info.name: SilverHouse API Collection
info.description:
Complete and official Postman collection for the SilverHouse e-commerce application and artisanal studio backend.

### Overview
SilverHouse is a luxury 925 & 999 artisanal pure silver e-commerce store with an administrative studio. This collection covers:
- **Customer Authentication**: WhatsApp OTP verification, session management, customer profile.
- **Admin Authentication & Studio**: Admin credentials login, password change, session checking.
- **Custom Artisanal Orders (Bespoke)**: Customer custom requests with inspiration photos, quotes, customer approval & payment, admin decision workflow.
- **Admin Analytics & P&L**: Catalog gross margins, custom order conversion rates, category profitability.
- **Commerce Features**: Cart management, checkout, order tracking, address book, wishlist, recently viewed products, customer reviews with photos.
- **Media Uploads**: Single and multi-image uploads.
- **Data API Gateway (`/api/data`)**: Direct access to stored procedures for full database CRUD operations.

### Environments
Switch between **SilverHouse Local** (http://localhost:5001), **SilverHouse Production** (https://api.silverhouseindia.com), and **SilverHouse Render**.

item.name: 01. Customer Authentication (WhatsApp OTP)
item.description: Customer registration and login via automated WhatsApp OTP verification. Includes session verification and profile updates.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit verification code to the customer's WhatsApp number. Test account `9999999999` uses static OTP `123456` with 10 days validity.

exec: console.log('Customer Auth Token saved successfully:', json.token);

request.description: Verifies the 6-digit WhatsApp OTP. If the user doesn't exist, an account is automatically created. Returns a base64 session token and saves it to `{{authToken}}` and `{{userId}}`.
Verifies active customer session against database using the Bearer token.
Updates customer full name or mobile number.
Alternative PUT endpoint for updating customer profile.
Notice informing legacy callers that customer authentication has transitioned to instant WhatsApp OTP.
Notice informing callers that customer registration is instant via WhatsApp OTP.

item.name: 02. Admin Portal & Authentication
item.description: Secure administrator credentials login (username/phone + password), token verification, and password management.

request.description: Authenticates an administrator with username/phone and password (supports plaintext or SHA-256 hashed passwords). Automatically sets `{{adminToken}}`.
Validates active admin session token against `dbo.[user]` where `role = 'ADMIN'`.
Allows an authenticated administrator to change their login password.

item.name: 03. Custom Artisanal Orders (Bespoke)
item.description: End-to-end bespoke commissioning workflow: customer submits requirements & reference photos, admin silversmith reviews & sets quotation price, customer accepts & pays online with automated WhatsApp notifications.

formdata.value: Handcrafted 925 sterling silver Mukut with floral filigree for Radha Krishna deity (height: 6 inches, weight ~150g).

formdata.description: Select reference images or photos from local filesystem

request.description: Customer places a custom order request with specifications and multi-file reference photos. Customer must be logged in (`user_id` required).
Customer retrieves their own submitted custom orders with current quotation and confirmation status.
Customer accepts the quotation and marks the approved custom order as PAID. Order must be in 'accepted' status.

query.description: Filter by confirm status: processing | accepted | rejected

request.description: Admin fetches all custom bespoke orders with customer contact information, reference images, and quotations.
Admin updates artisan decision ('processing' | 'accepted' | 'rejected') and sets the final quotation price. Triggers an automated WhatsApp notification to the customer.

item.name: 04. Admin Analytics & P&L
item.description: Executive studio analytics calculating catalog gross margins, material vs labor costs, custom order conversion rates, and category profitability.

request.description:
Returns aggregated financial metrics:
- Catalog potential & realized revenue, actual costs, labour costs, gross margins
- Custom order KPIs: total, processing, accepted, rejected, acceptance & rejection rates, quoted revenue
- Category breakdowns & recent order activity

item.description: Tracks and retrieves products viewed by patrons (saved in `dbo.viewed` for members, and via query parameters for guests).

request.description: Records a viewed product into `dbo.viewed` via `dbo.SP_viewed`.
Fetches recent products viewed by the logged-in customer.

query.description: Comma-separated product IDs stored in guest's local storage

request.description: Fetches full product cards and image URLs for a list of comma-separated IDs viewed by a guest.

item.name: 06. Customer Reviews & Ratings
item.description: Customer testimonials, star ratings (1-5), comments, and customer upload photos stored in `dbo.review`.

request.description: Submits a review with rating and up to 5 photos.
Fetches all verified reviews and computes aggregate rating for a product.

item.name: 6.3 Get Reviews for Specific Review ID

item.description: Store-wide configuration including theme presets, WhatsApp API endpoint, festival banners, and verified company details.
